blocks.orig: Make a dayhike on the Shira plateau, halfway up the famous Mount Kilimanjaro! This hike is perfect for those who want to experience the Kili, without actually going to the top. A driver takes you up to the Londorossi Gate on the westside of the mountain, at an altitude of 3,407 meters. Here your five-hour hike with an ascent of more than 1,000 meters begins, steadily up through tropical mountain forests. You might even spot some special monkeys and birds!
blocks.html: Spend a day hiking on the Shira plateau, halfway up the well-known Mount Kilimanjaro! This walk is ideal if you would like to experience Kili without climbing all the way to the summit. A driver brings you to the Londorossi Gate on the western side of the mountain, at an altitude of 3,407 meters. This is where your five-hour hike starts, climbing more than 1,000 meters at a steady pace through tropical mountain forest. You may even see some special monkeys and birds along the way!
